targets.expr: topk(5,sum by (accountId)(iotbridge_azure_iot_connections{accountId=~"${accountId:regex}", serviceId=~"${serviceId:regex}"})) * on(accountId) group_left(accountName) max by (accountId, accountName) (iotbridge_account_map)

topk(5, sum by (accountId) (rate(iotbridge_trigger_action_exectime_count{pod=~"svc-azure-iot-.+", accountId=~"${accountId:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(accountId) group_left(accountName) max by (accountId, accountName) (iotbridge_account_map)

sum by (accountId, serviceId) (iotbridge_azure_iot_connections{accountId=~"${accountId:regex}", serviceId=~"${serviceId:regex}"}) * on(accountId,serviceId) group_left(accountName,serviceName) max by (accountId, serviceId, accountName, serviceName) (iotbridge_service_map{accountId=~"${accountId:regex}", serviceId=~"${serviceId:regex}"})
